description:
Replace literal well-known `.jit` file names in repository-state code with `VirtualPath` constants.

## Background

`VirtualPath` declares well-known data-root files through `declare_well_known_paths!` (`crates/jit/src/repository_state/path.rs:259-310`), and host paths derive through `RepositoryLayout::resolve` (`path.rs:530`). Repository-state code still spells them as literals: `repository_state/profile_apply.rs` (17 lines), `repository_state/materialize.rs` (17), `repository_state/initialize.rs` (7), `repository_state/projection_render.rs` (3) and `repository_state/mod.rs`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No string literal under `crates/jit/src/repository_state/`, outside `path.rs`, builds or matches the path of a well-known `.jit` file; message text that names a file for a reader is not a path site.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each such site uses a `VirtualPath` constant, and host paths derive through `RepositoryLayout::resolve`.
title: Repository-state code names well-known files through VirtualPath constants
